moment: Permanent couple component

moment: Contemporaneous component
definition: 38's two-window design: father x stack units with the wife employed at baseline, events 1987-2021, both windows covered; two rows per couple (placebo window ev-4..ev-2, window ev-1..ev+1); y = wife displaced in the window; event year x window FE; regressors: husband ever displaced (treated or future placebo, first displacement in ev+4..ev+6) and treated x window. moment: P(she displaced | he is) - P( | he is not), same interval, all couple-years

Sector match at the interview opening the interval.

moment: P(she displaced | he is) - P( | he is not), same interval, same sector (16 sectors)
definition: 25's couple-years: consecutive interviews of the same couple, both spouses with positive annual hours in the earlier year, intervals ending 1984-2021 (one year to 1996, two years after); h / w = husband / wife displaced (closure, layoff or firing; own reports) in the interval. moment: P(she displaced | he is) - P( | he is not), same interval, different sector
definition: 25's couple-years: consecutive interviews of the same couple, both spouses with positive annual hours in the earlier year, intervals ending 1984-2021 (one year to 1996, two years after); h / w = husband / wife displaced (closure, layoff or firing; own reports) in the interval. moment: Wife's displacement rate per interval when he is not displaced, Black
definition: 25's couple-years: consecutive interviews of the same couple, both spouses with positive annual hours in the earlier year, intervals ending 1984-2021 (one year to 1996, two years after); h / w = husband / wife displaced (closure, layoff or firing; own reports) in the interval. moment: Wife's displacement rate per interval when he is not displaced, White

moment: Husband's annual displacement rate, working married male heads, Black
definition: 19's measure (section 1): share of male heads aged 20-60 with positive hours in the previous observed year who report a main displacement (closure, layoff/firing) dated to that calendar year; restricted here to heads with a wife present (the model's husbands); observed years 1984-2021.

moment: Husband's annual displacement rate, working married male heads, White
definition: 19's measure (section 1): share of male heads aged 20-60 with positive hours in the previous observed year who report a main displacement (closure, layoff/firing) dated to that calendar year; restricted here to heads with a wife present (the model's husbands); observed years 1984-2021.

moment: Share of husbands displaced two or more times among husbands observed 10+ years, Black (T28)
definition: Husbands = the risk set of the annual displacement rate above (married male heads aged 20-60 with positive hours in the previous observed year), observed years 1984-2021; N = number of such observed years per husband (interview years only: one a year to 1996, every other year after), kept if N >= 10; share with two or more main displacements (19's definition: closure or layoff/firing) dated to those years. Mean N 14.4; T28 of proposals/paperA_identification_plan.md (over-dispersion along the (p_H, m_H) ridge).

moment: Share of husbands displaced two or more times among husbands observed 10+ years, White (T28)

moment: Wife's monthly non-temporary job-loss rate, he employed, Black

moment: Wife's monthly non-temporary job-loss rate, he employed, White

moment: Employment of wives with no job the month before, relative to wives whose husband stays employed, month 0 after his involuntary separation
definition: 40's added-worker path: base month b = tau-1, husband employed, wife with no job all month; H = 1 husband involuntary separation at tau = b+1 vs husband employed without one; outcome wife employed at tau+s; LPM with base panel x rotation x month FE.

moment: Employment of wives with no job the month before, relative to wives whose husband stays employed, month 1 after his involuntary separation
definition: 40's added-worker path: base month b = tau-1, husband employed, wife with no job all month; H = 1 husband involuntary separation at tau = b+1 vs husband employed without one; outcome wife employed at tau+s; LPM with base panel x rotation x month FE.

moment: Employment of wives with no job the month before, relative to wives whose husband stays employed, month 6 after his involuntary separation
definition: 40's added-worker path: base month b = tau-1, husband employed, wife with no job all month; H = 1 husband involuntary separation at tau = b+1 vs husband employed without one; outcome wife employed at tau+s; LPM with base panel x rotation x month FE.

moment: Monthly employment entry of non-employed wives, husband employed, pooled
definition: P(wife employed at t+1) among wives not employed at t (unemployed or out of the labor force) whose husband is employed at t and t+1; wife's composite weight; race = husband's race.

moment: Monthly employment entry of non-employed wives, husband employed, Black
definition: P(wife employed at t+1) among wives not employed at t (unemployed or out of the labor force) whose husband is employed at t and t+1; wife's composite weight; race = husband's race.

moment: Monthly employment entry of non-employed wives, husband employed, White

moment: Persistent monthly employment entry of non-employed wives, husband employed, pooled
definition: P(wife employed at t+1 and t+2) among wives not employed (unemployed or out of the labor force) at t-1 and t, husband employed at t and t+1, all four months in sample; wife's composite weight; race = husband's race. Filters one-month reversals (response error) identically in the model.

moment: Persistent monthly employment entry of non-employed wives, husband employed, Black
definition: P(wife employed at t+1 and t+2) among wives not employed (unemployed or out of the labor force) at t-1 and t, husband employed at t and t+1, all four months in sample; wife's composite weight; race = husband's race. Filters one-month reversals (response error) identically in the model.

moment: Persistent monthly employment entry of non-employed wives, husband employed, White
definition: P(wife employed at t+1 and t+2) among wives not employed (unemployed or out of the labor force) at t-1 and t, husband employed at t and t+1, all four months in sample; wife's composite weight; race = husband's race. Filters one-month reversals (response error) identically in the model.

moment: Wives' monthly exit from employment outside an involuntary separation, husband employed (SIPP counterpart)
definition: P(wife with no job all month m) among wives with a job in m-1 whose husband has a job in m-1 and m without an involuntary separation in m; exits whose job ended for an involuntary reason in m-1 or m are not counted; wife's person weight. Supplementary to the CPS target.

moment: Wives' monthly exit from employment without a job-loss reason, husband employed
definition: P(wife unemployed for a reason other than job loss -- job leaver, re-entrant, new entrant -- or out of the labor force at t+1) among wives employed at t whose husband is employed at t and t+1; job losers (PRUNTYPE 1-3) are not exits; wife's composite weight.

moment: Persistent monthly exit of wives from employment without a job-loss reason, husband employed
definition: P(wife unemployed for a reason other than job loss or out of the labor force at t+1, and not employed at t+2) among wives employed at t-1 and t, husband employed at t and t+1, all four months in sample; job losers at t+1 are not exits; wife's composite weight. Filters one-month reversals identically in the model.

moment: His employment 3 months after an involuntary separation

moment: His employment 3 months no separation (comparison)

definition: P(husband employed at tau+s) for husbands with (H = 1) / without (H = 0) an involuntary separation at tau, in 40's added-worker sample (husband employed and wife without a job at tau-1); wife's person weight.

moment: His annual hours, years 1-3 after displacement, Black
definition: 19's stacked event study (Cengiz et al.): fathers (male heads with a child 0-17 and positive hours at baseline) first displaced (closure or layoff/firing) in ev vs clean controls (no displacement to ev+6); father x stack and calendar year x stack FE; reference e = -2; events 1984-2021, outcome years to 2021. moment: Log earnings in the first full month of re-employment minus the last full month before an involuntary separation, 1-3 months without a job, husbands

moment: Two-year log wage growth, continuously employed wives, ages 25-34
definition: Two-year change in the log hourly wage (annual labor income / annual hours, 2000 $, $2-$200) of spouses with at least 1,000 annual hours in t and t+2 and, where the PSID observes it (annual interviews to 1996), in t+1; same couple in t and t+2; age of that spouse in t (interview age - 1); t = 1984-2019.

moment: Two-year log wage growth, continuously employed wives, ages 35-44

moment: Two-year log wage growth, continuously employed husbands, ages 25-34
definition: Two-year change in the log hourly wage (annual labor income / annual hours, 2000 $, $2-$200) of spouses with at least 1,000 annual hours in t and t+2 and, where the PSID observes it (annual interviews to 1996), in t+1; same couple in t and t+2; age of that spouse in t (interview age - 1); t = 1984-2019.

moment: Two-year log wage growth, continuously employed husbands, ages 35-44
definition: Two-year change in the log hourly wage (annual labor income / annual hours, 2000 $, $2-$200) of spouses with at least 1,000 annual hours in t and t+2 and, where the PSID observes it (annual interviews to 1996), in t+1; same couple in t and t+2; age of that spouse in t (interview age - 1); t = 1984-2019.

moment: Two-year log wage growth, continuously employed husbands, ages 45-54

definition: Married wives (25-59, same couple both years); re-entrants: zero annual hours in t-1 (a full calendar year out) and at least 260 hours in t; comparison: at least 1,000 hours in t-1 and t; log hourly wage in t ($2-$200, 2000 $); OLS with calendar-year FE and wife's age group (25-34 / 35-44 / 45-59); income years 1985-1996 only, because the biennial survey does not observe the year t-1.

moment: Wife employed, years 1-3 after his displacement, youngest 0-5

moment: Gross response of the wife's hours (wife kept her job), years 1-3, all
definition: 38's interaction model on 19's stacks (events 1984-2021, outcome years to 2021, wife present at baseline, J defined): displaced x e, J x e, displaced x J x e, J = the baseline wife's own displacement dated ev-1..ev+1 (0 if she did not work at baseline); outcome wife's annual hours. Gross = mean of displaced x e, e = +1..+3 (displaced families whose wife was not displaced vs control families whose wife was not displaced).

moment: Offset of the wife's hours response from joint losses, years 1-3
definition: 38's interaction model on 19's stacks (events 1984-2021, outcome years to 2021, wife present at baseline, J defined): displaced x e, J x e, displaced x J x e, J = the baseline wife's own displacement dated ev-1..ev+1 (0 if she did not work at baseline); outcome wife's annual hours. Offset = (P1 - P0) x own + P1 x triple (means over e = +1..+3), P1 / P0 = share of J among displaced / control father-stacks; implied net = gross + offset.

moment: Gross response of the wife's hours (wife kept her job), years 1-3, youngest 0-5

Gross = mean of displaced x e, e = +1..+3 (displaced families whose wife was not displaced vs control families whose wife was not displaced).

moment: Wives' employment, no child under 18
definition: PSID married couples (male head, wife present, head Black or White), income years 1984-2021, wife aged 25-59 in the income year (interview age - 1); annual hours from the family file. Employed = positive annual hours; youngest child in the family unit at the interview.

moment: Wives' employment, youngest 0-5
definition: PSID married couples (male head, wife present, head Black or White), income years 1984-2021, wife aged 25-59 in the income year (interview age - 1); annual hours from the family file. Employed = positive annual hours; youngest child in the family unit at the interview.

moment: Wives' employment, youngest 6-17
definition: PSID married couples (male head, wife present, head Black or White), income years 1984-2021, wife aged 25-59 in the income year (interview age - 1); annual hours from the family file. Employed = positive annual hours; youngest child in the family unit at the interview.

moment: Part-time share of employed wives
definition: PSID married couples (male head, wife present, head Black or White), income years 1984-2021, wife aged 25-59 in the income year (interview age - 1); annual hours from the family file. Part-time = annual hours below 1,560 (midway between the model's part-time 87 x 12 = 1,044 and full-time 173 x 12 = 2,076 hours) among those with positive hours.

moment: Part-time share of employed husbands
definition: PSID married couples (male head, wife present, head Black or White), income years 1984-2021, wife aged 25-59 in the income year (interview age - 1); annual hours from the family file. moment: Change in log total consumption, first three interviews after his single displacement, married couples, pooled
